author: Subscriptor
body:
Hey everybody ;)

I know there is already a thread like that, but I still see this thread needed. I've seen an issue today. I've notcied that there are many users that deserve Jr MapDev and the mapdev team does not want to give them the chance, and I think that everyone should be able to try for it, and maybe then the mapdev team will see potential in them. Some examples for people that deserve Jr MapDev in my opinion, are Zintenka, Ambivalence_, PokerFace and SacredFlameLava, and these are only few examples.

Example for a possible application format:

Username:

Experience in building:

Number of maps/projects you've made for the Avicus Network:

Images of your builds:

YAML Experience:

If you could add something to the Avicus network building team, what would it be?

How do you think you will benefit the team?

That's just an example, but I really think the users should have a chance because there is a lot of potential in not well known players, so when it's building apps, there is no bias, and no advantage for well known and popular players. 
Opinions?

replies.body:
Zintenka. I'm absolutely sickened of your behavior.

Ready for the community backlash at me. You aren't any more qualified than they would be, actually, they already are doing great with following everything in the team and they're doing exactly what mapdevs should do. Just because you are not a mapdev doesn't mean you get the right to scream about why you aren't one and why you are able to put others down to build yourself up. If you scream "wolf", you know what's coming to you when you aren't going to be promoted.

Acting poorly isn't an element or platform to base yourself on to become a map developer. We wanted to promote you a looooong time ago, but you want to know what got in the way? Your attitude. We were ready for you, actually, in the old days, and we appreciated everything you did. You were among the veterans and you did awesome, but what else got in the way? You constantly pestering mapdevs about TNT, adding maps, and basically taking charge of a rank you don't even have. Now, you're taking charge of the forum with this topic so the community looks up to you, but you're no hero. Just let it sink in for a moment we really wanted you from however long ago, but this is the prime reason.

Want to know something? After you made the thread asking why you wanted to be mapdev, that killed it even more, it was an act of desperation. We STILL, ask ANY MAPDEV, reconsidered you, but it got shot down, because of your behavior. If you learned to clean up your act and be mature about things, and instead of the crying wolf, actually reported unqualified mapdevs to the head mapdev or even an admin, then this wouldn't be a problem. Stop making threads that revolve around yourself, and not others.

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Alright, so:

ParaSpider/Tanpopo/Tanpiku: Decision taken by Kylo. Very innovative person, has taken lead on numerous situations and is the oldest Map Developer of the Avicus Network, while he doesn't have much maps in rotations, he is biggest map creator of Avicus, being creator of: CubeMC, Lotus, Dragonblaze Peaks 1, Cobweb Hills, Brushwoods, Crescent: Chaos, Senex 3, Rendezvous 3, Palm Rust. Introduced many new concepts like OiTN (Thanks to him I built Zao 1, very popular map) and contributed majorly on bringing back CTW. Hardworking person, very funny and helpful as well. Old Map Developer, very experienced. 

Evocal/Astronis/UmbreonMessiah/timaeusTestified/Darkiur_: Decision taken by Para & Kylo. Creator Justice 1, Justice 2, Justice 3, Formorgar 1, Formorgar 2, Embers 1, Embers 2, Port Town 1, Port Town 2, Yellowstone, Sector Six, Alpha Complex, Mute City 1, Mute City 2, Mute City 3, Zao 1, Zao 2, Eclipse, Gold Rush, Illegal Office, Nucleus, Sanatorium, Carne Vale, Dreadlock, Arizona, Quicksand, Fairy Hills, Altaris, Amazon 2, Dredmor, Oeilvert, Edron, Dragonblaze Peaks 1, Dragonblaze Peaks 2, Orion, Block Fort, Scribblewood. Old Map Developer, very experienced. 

itaity: Promoted due to his inmense knowledge in maps of the Walls gamemode. Creator of The Vale, Mesoplanet (one of a kind map), Oz, Vacuum, Wild West, Infernus. His personality was always nice, very spontaneous person, he was pretty active and really helpful until his retirement. He will be missed by many and he never got the appreciation he deserved, imo. I miss you itaitles :(

AwarriorVenom/Exzyy/Archeonixx: Promoted due to being very skilled in Map Making (aesthetically wise). He learned YML and was someone who we thought would reach far. Later he retired, came back, and was demoted.

Shirokamii: Decision taken by himself, later demoted due to inactivity from both Senior Moderator and Map Developer positions.

TheHoopsman/ScriptingCookies/FlareonMessiah/SkylarCalibrator/Skyadia: Promoted due to his inmense dedication to Map Making and his always in-control and generally kind behavior. Very helpful, always willing to help, excellent person. His most popular map is Consilium, followed by Carne Vale, Coconut: DTM, Coconut: Walls, Cold City, and others. Helped in the revampment of Justice 1, Eclipse, Windmill Plains/Cleyra.

Slicorn/iMercury/xArcturus/BrokenVacuum/Darkye_: Promoted due to big improvement in Map Making related content. Started off as a standard builder and improved all way to Map Developer. Very kind, calm person, always willing to help and extremely polite (extremely). Has inmense knowledge in YML features and is currently our Head Map Developer for the Staff Section. Creator of Gladekeep, Mistrock, Dry Heaven 1, Dry Heaven 2, Port Town 2, Embers 2, Scorched Earth, Echo Valley, etc.

Polar_Express: Has shown improvement on his attitude (is known to have a few conflicts with others in the past), and he has made the most maps on Walls category as well as introduced new concepts to it (Monsterbash & Grotto Arena with Villager Trading, Springwood with 2 teams, Lands with different quadrants, etc). Has made a bunch of Nebula maps to test possible new concepts, has payed of very well. Really active and helpful. Creator of Blue Cove, Knight's Tower, Lands, Lost Island, Mini Mushrooms, Mini Walls, Overworld, Pirate's Cove, Smallcrypt, Springwood, Tinyjungle, Vanilla.

Zedther/Heracr0ss: Promoted due to his sudden improvement in Map Making content, knowledge in YML, being a well-behaved person, and having high expectations on him. Later demoted for inactivity regarding Github commits.

MumbleGod/Pavlo: Terrific improvement in Map Making content, very experienced YML coder, and has made various land based and void maps. Creator of Revixit, Abandoned Dam, Shadow Forest, Clearmont 1, Clearmont 2, Hyper Paradise, Sunbeam Temple. Very active, kind, helpful, trustworthy and really experienced terraformed with VoxelSniper and WorldEdit. Capable of executing various building styles.

You want me to keep going? I have all day.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
No, Junior Map Developer applications or such will not be happening. If you think about it enough, it should be clear sense. Easily, people could lie about their past/current experiences with map related content. With either, map stealing, forcing others to do it for them, etc. It would be a rather complicated system. The current selection system, based around hand picking players is quite a useful method. It allows us to gather positive/negative comments on the candidate. This is way more productive and ensures that we are choosing a map developer that corresponds to the requirements. Leaving us with our own truthful opinions about that candidate, rather then it just being fake.

And, clearly, as the other Map Developers have stated in this topic already, we currently have enough Map Developers on our hands. Yes, if you're wondering "Why didn't this person get Map Developer? He/she did a lot of work around the map sector". Well you see, we have documents, discussions and more to consider, that not only is the person good in map related content, but also has a fairly good attitude on the server and forums. We consider every aspect of them. So we know what we're doing.

And, if you have a problem with some promotions in Map Developers, please contact me, Darkiur_, or any of the admins.
